body.answer:
Tesla (TSLA): Halal. Its main business is permissible, and its available financial figures pass the halal checks.

Permissible core business
Borrowing is within the screening limit.
Interest-bearing deposits are within the screening limit.
Income from prohibited sources is within the screening limit.

−20.4% over 12 months (price only), as of 2 Oct 2026.

Screening is informational, not a fatwa.
